name: Temple of Athena Nike
heritage: part of UNESCO World Heritage Site; archaeological site in Greece
text: The Temple of Athena Nike  (Greek: Ναός Αθηνάς Νίκης, Naós Athinás Níkis), the smallest temple on the Acropolis of Athens, is dedicated to the goddesses Athena and Nike. Built around 420 BC, the temple is the earliest (and purest expression of) fully Ionic temple on the Acropolis. It has a prominent position on a steep bastion at the southwest corner of the Acropolis to the right of the entrance, the Propylaea.
